meta.name: market-research
meta.description: Conduct market research, competitive analysis, investor due diligence, and industry intelligence with source attribution and decision-oriented summaries. Use when the user wants market sizing, competitor comparisons, fund research, technology scans, or research that informs business decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取带来源标注的市场调研与竞争分析摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速了解市场格局或评估竞争对手
copy.tagline_en: Get market research and competitive analysis summaries with source attribution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick market insights or competitor evaluations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你做市场研究、竞争分析、投资者尽职调查和行业情报。它会给出有来源的决策导向摘要，并区分事实、推断和建议。
howto.when: 当你需要市场规模估算、竞争对手比较、基金研究、技术扫描或任何支持商业决策的研究时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份电动汽车市场的竞争分析。
say.note: Claude 会收集产品、融资、用户数据并给出对比。

say.text: 分析红杉资本的投资偏好和近期动态。
say.note: Claude 会整理基金规模、阶段、组合公司等信息。

say.text: 估算中国 SaaS 市场的 TAM/SAM/SOM。
say.note: Claude 会使用自上而下和自下而上的方法估算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will conduct market research, competitive analysis, investor due diligence, and industry intelligence. It produces decision-oriented summaries with source attribution, separating facts, inferences, and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need market sizing, competitor comparisons, fund research, technology scans, or any research that informs business decisions.

say_en.text: Run a competitive analysis of the electric vehicle market.
say_en.note: Claude will gather product, funding, traction data and compare.

say_en.text: Analyze Sequoia Capital's investment thesis and recent activity.
say_en.note: Claude will compile fund size, stage, portfolio, etc.

say_en.text: Estimate TAM/SAM/SOM for the Chinese SaaS market.
say_en.note: Claude will use top-down and bottom-up approaches.
